texts.text:
iSupport-Digital (iSupport-D) is an online program designed to support family carers of people living with dementia and aged care workers, especially those from culturally and linguistically diverse communities.
Based on the World Health Organization’s iSupport program, iSupport-D has been culturally adapted for carers in Australia.
Through the platform, users can access:
Multilingual learning modules and short videos to build caregiving skills
Culturally tailored tips and information relevant to your situation
A dementia service finder to help you locate local support
Online support groups in different languages
Helpful reminders and encouragement to stay on track
An interactive chatbot to help you quickly find what you need. For example, you can ask: “My dad is becoming aggressive — what should I do?”. The chatbot will guide you to the most relevant lesson, video, or resource in the app.
These features are designed to help you feel more confident, informed, and supported in your caregiving journey.

The program focuses on carers from Arabic-, Cantonese-, Italian-, Mandarin-, and Vietnamese-speaking communities and is developed by a research team specialising in digital health and dementia care, in partnership with carers and community organisations.
For more information:  ediva@nari.edu.au
